about: Every file the game loads at start. A model that fails to load is skipped and the game uses its stand-in. clips: animation names the game needs from that file. A character model from another program can be listed with the id "hero" (see newgame/prompts/character_import.md); without one, the player's body is built from the look chosen on the character screen. opening: the three opening pictures in order (newgame/prompts/opening_stills.md); without them they are drawn in code.
